Name: Yagisan's Krobus Shop Expanded
Author: Yagichan
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=5]Introduction[/size]

This mod was created because finding the dwarf scrolls is purely by chance in the base game. In game it is established that Krobus and the Dwarf do understand each other, so it is logical to assume Krobus will "acquire" dwarf scrolls. Upon reaching 4 hearts with Krobus, he will have 1 dwarf scroll, selected randomly, each day.

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
